mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over three months do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate falls below 2% YoY, it signals a tightening monetary policy with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 65% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy with strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong growth
failure_condition: If the combined trigger condition does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 65% of triggered instances.
